scope: RK3588 IPC P3 partial: four-arm communication, follower initialization and supervised zero-gravity checks

per_motor_communication.method: Each arm joint motor ID 1-6 was enabled, read once, and explicitly disabled; no position target was sent.

invalid_gravity_trial.configuration: physical linear_4310 attached but software used no_gripper to avoid calibration
invalid_gravity_trial.interpretation: Not valid evidence for YAM gravity compensation because the software model omitted the physical gripper mass and inertia.
invalid_gravity_trial.shutdown_observation: Pinned i2rt v1.2.4 reproduced the control-thread/CAN-socket close race described by upstream PR 81.
invalid_gravity_trial.postcondition: Motor IDs 1-6 were explicitly disabled after the trial.

i2rt_shutdown_fix.upstream_status: official repository pull request 81, open when checked
i2rt_shutdown_fix.change: Retain and join the DMChain control thread before closing its CAN socket.
i2rt_shutdown_fix.deployment: Thin git bundle transferred over the LAN because the IPC submodule remote was a developer-host local path.
i2rt_shutdown_fix.result: The negative-file-descriptor shutdown exception did not recur in the official left-follower initialization.

official_left_follower_initialization.shutdown: zero-torque command, patched bounded thread join, then explicit motor-off replies for IDs 1-7

official_right_follower_initialization.shutdown: zero-torque command, patched bounded thread join, then explicit motor-off replies for IDs 1-7

dual_follower_supervised_float_test.configuration: Both standard YAM followers used their measured linear_4310 limits, so startup skipped repeated gripper calibration; no home or synchronization target was sent.
dual_follower_supervised_float_test.physical_payload: Both followers carried their installed wrist cameras.
dual_follower_supervised_float_test.operator_observation: Both arms could be pushed gently and basically remained where released; no material issue was observed.
dual_follower_supervised_float_test.result: pass for supervised qualitative zero-gravity behavior with the current wrist-camera payload
dual_follower_supervised_float_test.shutdown_recovery: The first post-close explicit motor-off helper had a shell-quoting NameError. Both robot objects had already completed zero-torque close; a separate immediate recovery then received OFF replies from motor IDs 1-7 on both followers.
dual_follower_supervised_float_test.final_state: Both follower interfaces and both leader interfaces DOWN.

leader_handle_passive_readout.method: 100 passive encoder reads per handle at 100 Hz; leader arm motors were not enabled and encoder zero was not written.
leader_handle_passive_readout.interpretation: Both released-handle readings are close to the official near-zero expectation and the idle button bits were stable; no routine encoder re-zero is indicated.
leader_handle_passive_readout.remaining: Button press transitions still require supervised checks.

dual_leader_supervised_float_test.configuration: Both official YAM leaders used yam_teaching_handle with bilateral_kp=0; no follower synchronization or position target was enabled.
dual_leader_supervised_float_test.operator_observation: Both leaders were manually tested and the operator reported no material issue.
dual_leader_supervised_float_test.result: pass for supervised qualitative active leader zero-gravity behavior
dual_leader_supervised_float_test.shutdown: Both leader objects completed zero-torque close; motor IDs 1-6 on both channels then acknowledged explicit OFF.

recording_regression_fix.observation: A full-suite run intermittently saw RecordingSession.episodes update before the atomic session.json checkpoint became visible.
recording_regression_fix.change: Write the candidate episode list to session.json before publishing the in-memory completion signal.
recording_regression_fix.verification: The focused checkpoint test passed 20 consecutive runs; the final full suite passed 263 tests with 2 skipped and 17 subtests.

device_initialization_platform.workflow: Five in-page steps: read-only inventory preflight, three-camera validation, initialization-only four-arm connection, supervised follower/leader gravity checks, and atomic local acceptance report.
device_initialization_platform.safety: Initialization reuses the production Runtime in collect/hold, blocks start/record/mode changes, does not require a collection task, does not write motor zeros, and does not command home.
device_initialization_platform.mock_ui: At desktop width the visible wizard progressed from 0/5 to 3/5 through preflight, cameras and four-arm mock connection; the safety confirmation was displayed before connection.

lan_service.service: yam-workstation.service user unit, enabled and active
lan_service.browser_observation: A separate LAN client rendered the real-device workstation with devices disconnected.
lan_service.live_ui_camera_validation: The LAN client clicked Devices -> read-only preflight -> connect cameras. The wizard reached 2/5, all three streams rendered live, each reported 30 fps with observed frame ages about 10-30 ms, and device health showed 3/3 online.
lan_service.security: Same-origin POST token and explicit Host allowlist retained; wildcard bind requires an explicit allowed host.
lan_service.postcondition: Cameras remain connected for continued page-based testing; no arm connection was requested and all four CAN interfaces remained DOWN.

live_arm_initialization.first_attempt: The LAN page failed closed before constructing the left pair because can_left was still DOWN; no arm connection was established and the cameras stayed online.
live_arm_initialization.fix: The production HIL path now resets station CAN to 1 Mbit/s, verifies every configured channel before opening i2rt, and returns only the owned station channels DOWN after releasing devices.
live_arm_initialization.retry: The operator-authorized LAN-page retry connected two followers and two official leaders in collect/hold without selecting a collection task or starting teleoperation.
live_arm_initialization.gripper_behavior: Both follower startups logged enable_gripper_calibration=False with the pinned limits [0.62123, -5.04368] and [0.07038, -5.03948]; no endpoint sweep or home command ran.
live_arm_initialization.live_health: Four sdk_state_age_s values remained about 0.4-2.2 ms in the observed samples; three cameras remained healthy around 30 fps; both leader button pairs were released.
live_arm_initialization.can: can_left, can_right, can_lead_l and can_lead_r were UP/ERROR-ACTIVE at 1 Mbit/s with zero RX/TX errors, drops, bus errors and bus-off while the session remained active.
live_arm_initialization.post_connection_fault: At 18:31:30, about 21 seconds after the page reported the four-arm connection, right follower motor 7 returned DM error 0xC. The i2rt control thread stopped and the page disabled maintenance controls. The operator then requested page disconnect; all four robot objects reported zero-torque close and all four station CAN interfaces returned DOWN.
live_arm_initialization.root_cause: The pinned i2rt PR #81 tree still contained the bug documented by upstream draft PR #82 commit e599e9d: startup +/-2pi encoder correction iterated over all seven motors. The right linear gripper's saved open endpoint is -5.03948 rad, so starting while open can spuriously change motor 7's offset by -2pi while retaining the old endpoints. A subsequent normalized hold target can therefore map about 1.17 rad beyond the physical open endpoint and sustain force at the stop.
live_arm_initialization.error_interpretation: The DM-J4310 manual assigns feedback status C to motor-coil over-temperature. The raw temperature bytes were not retained, so the report proves the controller returned status C but does not reconstruct the actual winding temperature curve.
live_arm_initialization.remediation: Vendor the exact e599e9d correction as patches/i2rt/0002-exclude-gripper-wrap.patch, apply it during deployment, and fail closed in yam_adapter before opening hardware when the corrected helper is absent. The full 12-open-PR audit also identified PR #61 commit 3916586 as directly relevant to RK3588: it removes a duplicate inverse-dynamics call without changing returned gravity torque, and is vendored separately as 0003-single-inverse-dynamics.patch. Do not reactivate the right follower until it has cooled and the mechanism is checked for binding.
live_arm_initialization.performance_caveat: Initial hold samples showed frequent 30 Hz deadline misses and io_read p95 above one tick; quantify and optimize this before claiming long-duration control performance.

device_initialization_platform.verification: 270 tests passed, 2 skipped, 17 subtests passed; the upstream wrap regression passed against a temporary PR #81 tree with both vendored patches applied; a synthetic regression confirmed gravity compensation calls inverse dynamics exactly once with and without a gripper while preserving output shape; focused Ruff and git diff checks passed.

passed: Four independent CAN mappings communicate with arm motor IDs 1-6 at 1 Mbit/s.
Left follower initializes with the correct standard YAM and linear_4310 model.
Left linear gripper auto-calibration returns a non-collapsed range.
Left follower numerical drift and CAN transport remain bounded for the measured 10-second window.
Right follower initializes and calibrates with bounded 10-second numerical drift and no CAN errors.
Both followers qualitatively float and hold under supervised manual testing with wrist cameras installed.
Both official leaders qualitatively float under supervised manual testing with yam_teaching_handle configured.
Patched shutdown completes without the observed CAN-socket race and all seven left-follower motors acknowledge OFF.
not_yet_passed: Single-pair and dual-pair low-amplitude synchronization, direction, pause and emergency-stop behavior.
A taught ready/home pose; no all-zero home command has been issued.
